a.xlink:title: Samples and triangulates one request, returning null when local terrain is absent.
Samples a sea-level water surface while retaining source depth for coloring.
Returns one decoded elevation in metres, excluding the DTED no-data sentinel.
Returns a post classification, or no value for invalid coordinates/data.
Returns true when dimensions and storage form a bounded usable Level-0 cell.
Returns whether dimensions, coverage, and optional mixed payload agree.
Loads and verifies one cell whose dimensions must match its DTED cell.
